title: [scan-yield] isIdleScannerRun: characterization test for the idle scanner-run check
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for isIdleScannerRun in src/scan-yield.ts: idle scanner runs
- isIdleScannerRun({ display_title: "Scanner restarter" }) is true
- isIdleScannerRun({ display_title: "Scanner tenmin daily (off)" }) is true
- isIdleScannerRun({ display_title: "Scanner" }) is false
- isIdleScannerRun({ display_title: null }) is false

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v2): Peace's task (source: peace). The check that decides which scanner.yml runs never call Massive or write R2 (restarter, or daily tick switched off) has no direct test; this pins its current behaviour. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 5c41528 (Workspace main efd3f76, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v2); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with isIdleScannerRun stubbed); suite 564/564 with all eight new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
